rows.question: How did the RAG paper demonstrate updating the model's knowledge by swapping the index?
rows.raw_answer: The RAG paper demonstrated updating the model's knowledge by replacing the non-parametric memory with a newer index, as shown in [rag_lewis2020.pdf, p.2][rag_lewis2020.pdf, p.7]. They built an index using the Wikipedia dump from December 2016 and compared outputs from RAG using this index to the newer index from their main results (December 2018). They observed that by simply updating the index, the model's knowledge can be easily updated as the world changes. [rag_lewis2020.pdf, p.2][rag_lewis2020.pdf, p.7]
